dataset.name: small hand-specified fixture (not a modification of the frozen apparel/automotive generators)

repetitions: 5 independent full runs; correctness/wrong-family/row1/negative numbers are deterministic byte-for-byte across all 5 (confirmed by direct diff); latency is the median of 7 black_box-guarded batched trials per row per run, but still shows real run-to-run (separate process invocation) variance at this catalog's few-microsecond absolute scale -- see second_correction_round

headline_result.treatment_a: FAILS the GO gate: silently keeps only the Numeric interpretation as the sole hard constraint for the uncorroborated ambiguous query (no OR/preference fallback for the Enum reading at all), and 0 hits for the corroborated apparel case ("size 22 jeans") since the unconditional Numeric constraint ANDs against ProductType(Jeans) and the Jeans product's own size is Enum-typed -- corroborated mean NDCG@10 = 0.6667. Confirms H1-A.
headline_result.treatment_b: corroborated mean NDCG@10 = 1.0000 (recovers every missed match), but introduces exactly 1 wrong-family false positive on the dedicated adversarial case (a "Bolt Kits" product whose unrelated thread_count attribute coincidentally shares the ambiguous value's literal text) across all 5 runs -- confirms H1-B. FAILS the GO gate (requires 0).
headline_result.treatment_c: 0 wrong-family false positives, correctly falls back for the uncorroborated case, but corroborated mean NDCG@10 = 0.3333, far below the 0.95 bar -- genuinely FAILS the GO gate on that basis. A second-correction-round diagnostic (resolve_c_isolated_no_residual_push) found this score is NOT actually evidence of 'never uses corroborating context to select an interpretation' as originally claimed -- an isolated variant differing only in not triggering execute_planned's residual-lexical strict veto (R2's own subject) scores a perfect 1.0000, identical to D, on the same rows. Most of C's measured gap vs. D is attributable to that confound, not to corroboration-blindness; see second_correction_round.
headline_result.treatment_d: Passes every correctness criterion: corroborated mean NDCG@10 = 1.0000, 0 wrong-family false positives, correct row-1 fallback-to-demotion, 0 hard constraints surviving either negative case. FAILS only the <=5% latency-overhead bar: 13.6%-17.8% overhead vs Treatment A across this pass's 5 runs (median-of-7-trials each; 10.2%-18.0% combined with an earlier batch of 5 runs before this pass's diagnostic section was added -- see second_correction_round), attributable to this experimental implementation's O(catalog-size) per-query attribute-kind-registration scan rather than a precomputed ingestion-time index.
headline_result.verdict: REVISE. No treatment clears every preregistered GO-gate threshold. Treatment D is the closest (passes every correctness/wrong-family/fallback criterion, fails only a measured, explicable, plausibly-fixable implementation-cost dimension). Current production behavior (Treatment A / unmodified compile()) is retained; D is not adopted in this pass.
headline_result.reproducibility: all 5 runs byte-identical on every correctness/wrong-family/row1/negative number (verified by direct diff excluding the latency_ms_per_call JSON block and the output-file-path line)
headline_result.second_correction_round: A fresh adversarial reviewer with no implementation task found: (1) the latency-overhead ranges this pass first published (B 2.6%-6.8%, C 42.4%-50.8%, D 11.6%-21.1%) did not match the raw run artifacts cited as their source -- the true per-run figures included 2 negative values for B and a true D minimum (10.2%) below the published floor; fixed by regenerating a fresh 5-run batch and citing only numbers read directly from the committed files, and disclosing (not hiding) that cross-run latency variance remains real even after the median-of-7 within-run correction; (2) an internal '10 independent runs' vs '5' inconsistency in the YAML manifest; (3) a test-count error (7, not 9, r1_workload tests); (4) the Treatment C causal-explanation confound described above; (5) a missing unit-test branch for row1_does_not_silently_pick_one_family. All five independently reproduced before being fixed; none reverses the REVISE verdict or which treatment is retained. Full detail: docs/experiments/ISSUE42_LOG.md's 'Second correction round' section.
